title: Name On The Lid
subject: four flatmates interrogating each other over a strawberry yoghurt with a name written on the lid
caption: Global girl-group pop in the current K-pop-system style, sung in English. A punchy 808 kick with tight hi-hat rolls only under the rap verse; Latin-pop nylon-string guitar flourishes between the lines; stacked synth-brass stabs announcing each chorus; a dance break with a hard beat switch to half-time; the last chorus lifting up a key. Glossy and wide, the drums and stacked voices forward, the nylon guitar close and dry. Four young female voices trading lines: a bright lead soprano, a cool low alto, a quick spoken-rap verse, unison group chants on the hook, and one belted high note in the bridge. 118 BPM, C-sharp minor. Sassy, accusatory and danceable. No autotune, no EDM supersaw drop, no ballad piano, no male voices, no sampled voice hooks.
lyrics:
[Intro - synth brass stab and nylon guitar flourish]

[Verse 1 - lead soprano]
Strawberry yoghurt, top shelf, at the front
My name on the lid in black Sharpie
Seven in the morning, I open the fridge
And there's nothing on the shelf but a spoon

[Pre-Chorus - low alto]
Somebody in this flat
Has got some explaining to do

[Chorus - group chant]
Name on the lid! (Name on the lid!)
Who ate it? Who ate it?
Name on the lid! (Name on the lid!)
I wrote it big and I underlined it

[Verse 2 - spoken rap]
Jess is vegan, okay, that's a solid alibi
Priya slept at her boyfriend's, she's got the bus ticket
Leah's very quiet, Leah's very quiet
Leah, why is there pink on your chin?

[Chorus - group chant]
Name on the lid! (Name on the lid!)
Leah ate it! Leah ate it!
Name on the lid! (Name on the lid!)
She says she thought Maya was the brand

[Bridge - belted high note]
It's my name, Leah, it's my name
I've lived here for two years

[Dance Break - half-time beat switch, synth brass and claps]

[Chorus - group chant, key change up]
Name on the lid! (Name on the lid!)
Leah, that's mine! Leah, that's mine!
Name on the lid! (Name on the lid!)
Next time I'm writing it on the spoon

[Outro - nylon guitar and claps]
New rule on the fridge door
Leah buys the four-pack every Friday
